mapper.sql: p.status = 'active' and s.status = 'active' and p.study_mode = 'full_time' and exists ( select 1 from program_subject ps408 join subject sub408 on sub408.id = ps408.subject_id where ps408.program_id = p.id and sub408.code = '408' )

case when sc.score_line is not null and ar.min_admitted_score is not null and ar.max_admitted_score is not null and ar.avg_admitted_score is not null and (ap.total_plan is not null or ap.unified_exam_quota is not null or ar.admitted_count is not null) then 'A' when sc.score_line is not null and (ar.avg_admitted_score is not null or ar.min_admitted_score is not null or ap.total_plan is not null or ap.unified_exam_quota is not null) then 'B' when q.completeness_level is not null then q.completeness_level else 'C' end

left join ( select program_id, max(year) as year from ( select program_id, year from admission_score where score_line is not null union all select program_id, year from admission_result union all select program_id, year from admission_plan ) annual_facts group by program_id ) fact_year on fact_year.program_id = p.id left join admission_score sc on sc.program_id = p.id and sc.year = fact_year.year left join admission_plan ap on ap.program_id = p.id and ap.year = fact_year.year left join admission_result ar on ar.program_id = p.id and ar.year = fact_year.year left join program_year_data_quality q on q.program_id = p.id and q.year = fact_year.year

left join ( select program_id, url, title, source_owner from ( select ar2.program_id, ds2.url, ds2.title, ds2.source_owner, row_number() over ( partition by ar2.program_id order by case when ds2.title is null or trim(ds2.title) = '' or trim(ds2.title) like '%-' then 1 else 0 end, ar2.year desc, char_length(ds2.title) desc, ds2.id desc ) as rn from admission_result ar2 join data_source ds2 on ds2.id = ar2.source_id ) ranked_sources where rn = 1 ) preferred_ds on preferred_ds.program_id = p.id

left join admission_score sc on sc.program_id = p.id and sc.year = ( select max(sc2.year) from admission_score sc2 where sc2.program_id = p.id and sc2.score_line is not null ) left join admission_plan ap on ap.program_id = p.id and ap.year = sc.year left join admission_result ar on ar.program_id = p.id and ar.year = sc.year left join program_year_data_quality q on q.program_id = p.id and q.year = sc.year

select p.id as programId, s.id as schoolId, s.name as schoolName, s.province as province, s.city as city, s.tier as schoolTier, s.is_985 as is985, s.is_211 as is211, s.is_double_first as isDoubleFirst, c.name as collegeName, p.program_code as programCode, p.program_name as programName, p.research_direction as researchDirection, p.degree_type as degreeType, p.score_scale as scoreScale, p.protects_first_choice as protectsFirstChoice, p.is_joint_program as isJointProgram, subj.subject_codes as subjectCodes, subj.subject_names as subjectNames, as dataYear, sc.score_line as scoreLine, ap.total_plan as planCount, ap.unified_exam_quota as unifiedExamQuota, ap.retest_count as retestCount, ar.admitted_count as admittedCount, ar.min_admitted_score as admissionLow, ar.avg_admitted_score as avgAdmittedScore, ar.max_admitted_score as admissionHigh, as dataCompleteness, q.has_official_source as officialVerified, coalesce(preferred_ds.url, ar_ds.url, sc_ds.url, ap_ds.url) as sourceUrl, coalesce(preferred_ds.title, ar_ds.title, sc_ds.title, ap_ds.title) as sourceTitle, coalesce(preferred_ds.source_owner, ar_ds.source_owner, sc_ds.source_owner, ap_ds.source_owner, 'N诺') as sourceOwner from program p join college c on p.college_id = c.id join school s on c.school_id = s.id left join ( select ps.program_id, group_concat(sub.code order by ps.subject_order separator ',') as subject_codes, group_concat(sub.name order by ps.subject_order separator ' + ') as subject_names from program_subject ps join subject sub on ps.subject_id = sub.id group by ps.program_id ) subj on subj.program_id = p.id
left join data_source sc_ds on sc_ds.id = sc.source_id left join data_source ap_ds on ap_ds.id = ap.source_id left join data_source ar_ds on ar_ds.id = ar.source_id where p.id = #{programId} and
mapper.select: select p.id from program p join college c on c.id = p.college_id join school s on s.id = c.school_id where and p.id in #{id}
